# Scripts

<!-- Generated by build_readme.py from each script's header. Do not edit by hand. -->

Small command-line scripts. Python scripts run with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and declare their own dependencies inline, so there is nothing to install first.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build_readme.py`](build_readme.py) | regenerate scripts/README.md from the scripts in this folder. |
| [`wiki_info.py`](wiki_info.py) | Wikipedia URLs -> title, url, Wikidata Q-number, AutoDesc description. |

## `build_readme.py`

regenerate scripts/README.md from the scripts in this folder.

```bash
uv run scripts/build_readme.py          # rewrite scripts/README.md
uv run scripts/build_readme.py --check  # exit 1 if README is out of date
```

## `wiki_info.py`

Wikipedia URLs -> title, url, Wikidata Q-number, AutoDesc description.

```bash
uv run scripts/wiki_info.py                       # reads ./urls.txt, writes ./wiki-info.csv
uv run scripts/wiki_info.py --input links.csv --column link --output out.csv
uv run scripts/wiki_info.py --mode short          # short AutoDesc descriptions
uv run scripts/wiki_info.py --md notes.md         # also append a Markdown file
uv run scripts/wiki_info.py --no-desc             # title/url/Q only, no AutoDesc calls
uv run scripts/wiki_info.py --force               # redo URLs already in the output
```
